# 袭击行星 / Raid Planet

> 本文为人工审阅导读（评注），不是游戏原文；原文见阅读器。 / Reviewer guide (commentary), not original game text; the original text is in the reader.

- 分类 Category：C8 银河轶事 / Galactic miscellany
- 来源 Sources：`common/missions/missions/02_contracts.txt:1057-1302`; `common/event_chains/00_event_chains_nomads.txt:394`; `events/nomads_events_1.txt:11444-11491`
- DLC：Nomads
- 审阅 Reviewed：2026-10-13（已审阅 reviewed）

## 如何开始 How it starts

发布者要求对另一帝国的星系发动劫掠：目标系须属于另一默认类型国家，且该国至少有一颗殖民地；承包者须未在轰炸姿态“选择性轨道轰炸”下、与目标无互不侵犯/防御条约/附庸/联邦关系、无停战。费用 5000，接受期限1800天；AI 在目标舰队实力“优势”及以上时不会接受。

The issuer asks for raids on another empire's system: the target system must belong to another default-type country that owns a colony. The operator must not use the selective orbital bombardment policy, must have no non-aggression pact, defensive pact, subject/overlord or federation tie and no truce with the target. Cost 5000, acceptance window 1800 days; the AI will not accept if the target's fleet power is superior or better.

## 剧情脉络 Story outline

接受后承包者立刻向目标国宣战（战争目标 wg_raid_contract）。每当目标国行星被轰炸、破坏度较记录值上升≥1，计数器 +1（nomads.3015，11444-11491），共需 30 次（max=30）。契约结束时由 on_stop 结束该战争并清除标记。

On acceptance the operator immediately declares war on the target (war goal wg_raid_contract). Each time a planet of the target gains at least 1 devastation over its tracker the counter +1 (nomads.3015, 11444-11491); 30 are needed (max 30). On stop the war is ended and the flags cleared.

## 分支与结局 Branches and outcomes

完成：贸易 8250 + 合金 1650（放大）；若承包者拥有“雇佣兵”国民/企业雇佣兵政体则为 12500 + 2500 并获得永久 hired_guns_modifier；影响力 150，发布者好感 +150、信任 +15。 契约被取消、超时或中止时（on_cancel / on_stop），发布者对承包者的好感下降（opinion_failed_contract_*），事件链与全部兴趣点标记被清除。

Completion: trade 8250 + alloys 1650 (scaled); with the Hired Guns civic (civic_hired_guns / civic_corporate_hired_guns) it is 12500 + 2500 and a permanent hired_guns_modifier; influence 150, issuer opinion +150, trust +15. If the contract is cancelled, times out or is aborted (on_cancel / on_stop), the issuer's opinion of the operator drops (opinion_failed_contract_*), and the chain and all points of interest are cleared.

## 条件与文明差异 Conditions and variants

Hired Guns 国民/政体有更高报酬。

Hired Guns civics get a higher payout.

## 审阅记录 Review notes

对照契约定义、内联脚本、专项与事件钩子核实了发布/接受条件、完成方式、奖励与失败处理；事件链卡片是模型中唯一的可读文档（任务、专项与钩子事件不是文档），因此本导读承载结构。

The issue/accept conditions, completion mechanism, rewards and failure handling were checked against the mission, inline scripts, special projects and hook events; the chain card is the only readable doc in the model (missions, projects and hook events are not docs), so this guide carries the structure.
